content.title: Reproduce: investigate why shadcn-ui styles are not applied (transparent inputs/selects/modals)
content.description:
Reproduce and diagnose the styling bug. All webapp UI components (inputs, select boxes, modals) render transparent with unreadable content. Investigate:

- Is the global CSS (globals.css / index.css) being imported in the app entry point?
- Are the shadcn-ui CSS theme variables (--background, --foreground, --primary, etc.) defined and resolving?
- Is the Tailwind config correct (content paths, dark mode, theme extension)?
- Are component-level styles (e.g. from cn() / class-variance-authority) resolving?
- Check the build output / dev server for CSS-related warnings or errors.

Report the root cause(s) found, with specific file references. Do NOT fix — just diagnose and report.

content.content:
## Diagnosis: shadcn-ui styles not applied — ROOT CAUSE FOUND

**Status:** Diagnosed (not fixed, per task scope). Root cause is a missing Tailwind v4 theme/token definition block in the CSS.

### Primary root cause
** is missing the entire shadcn theme variables block.** The file is only 14 lines:

```css
@import "tailwindcss";

@layer utilities {
  .transition-fast { transition-duration: var(--agentrack-transition-duration-fast); }
  .transition-normal { ... }
  .transition-slow { ... }
}
```

It has NO `:root` block, NO `.dark` block, and NO `@theme inline { ... }` block defining the shadcn semantic color tokens.

### Why this makes everything transparent
This project uses **Tailwind v4** (`tailwindcss ^4.1.0` + `@tailwindcss/vite`, `@import "tailwindcss"` syntax). In v4, the shadcn semantic utility classes — `bg-background`, `bg-card`, `bg-primary`, `bg-popover`, `bg-input`, `bg-muted`, `text-foreground`, `text-muted-foreground`, `text-primary`, `border-input`, `border-border`, `border-ring`, `ring-ring`, etc. — are **only generated if you declare them in CSS** via `@theme inline { --color-background: var(--background); ... }` plus a `:root` / `.dark` block giving them HSL/oklch values.

Because none are declared, Tailwind v4 does not know what those tokens mean and **emits no CSS rules for them at all**.

### Definitive proof from the production build
I ran `npm run build` (succeeds, no CSS warnings) and inspected `dist/assets/index-*.css` (41.38 kB):

- The single `:root` block contains **only Tailwind's default palette** (red/amber/green/blue/purple/slate/white/black) — i.e. the built-in `--color-*` vars.
- **Zero** shadcn semantic tokens are defined: `grep -oE '--color-(background|foreground|primary|card|popover|input|ring|muted|accent|destructive|border|secondary)' dist/assets/index-*.css` → **empty**.
- **Zero rules exist** for the utilities the components use: `.bg-background`, `.bg-primary`, `.bg-card`, `.text-foreground`, `.border-input` → all return **0 matches**.

So class names like `bg-background` / `border-input` exist in the HTML but resolve to **nothing** → elements render with no background/border/text color = transparent / unreadable. This affects Input, Select, Dialog, DropdownMenu, Card, and every other `components/ui/*` component, since they all reference the same semantic tokens (verified across `input.tsx`, `dialog.tsx`, `select.tsx`, `dropdown-menu.tsx`).

### Secondary observations (not the cause, but relevant)
1. **No `tailwind.config.js` exists** — this is correct/expected for Tailwind v4 (config is optional; theme lives in CSS via `@theme`). Not a bug, but worth noting the previous shadcn `components.json` has `"config": ""` (empty) which is consistent with v4.
2. The `@layer utilities` block in `index.css` references `--agentrack-transition-duration-*` vars, but **those variables are also never defined anywhere** (no `:root` assignment). So the transition utilities likewise resolve to nothing — same class of bug, lower severity. Searched all of `src/` and `index.html` — no definition found.
3. `components.json` uses `"style": "base-nova"` (the new `@base-ui/react`-based shadcn style). Components import from `@base-ui/react/*` and those imports resolve (build succeeds), so that part is fine — the only thing missing is the theme/token CSS.

### What the fix needs (out of my scope — for the implementer)
Restore the standard shadcn Tailwind-v4 theme block in `src/index.css`, i.e.:
- A `@theme inline { ... }` block mapping `--color-background` → `var(--background)`, etc. for every semantic token used by the components, AND
- `:root { ... }` / `.dark { ... }` blocks giving each `--background`, `--foreground`, `--primary`, `--card`, `--popover`, `--input`, `--ring`, `--border`, `--muted`, `--accent`, `--secondary`, `--destructive` (and `-foreground` variants) concrete oklch/hsl values.
- Also define `--agentrack-transition-duration-fast/normal/slow` (e.g. in `:root`) so the transition utilities work.

A clean way to regenerate this correctly is to re-run `npx shadcn@latest init` (or `npx shadcn@latest add` on the affected components) against the existing `components.json`, which for the `base-nova` / Tailwind v4 setup will emit the correct `@theme` + `:root`/`.dark` blocks into `src/index.css`.

### Validation done
- `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json` → PASS (no type errors)
- `npm run build` → PASS (no CSS warnings/errors; 2104 modules; 41.38 kB CSS)
- Inspected built CSS to confirm semantic tokens/rules absent (details above).
- Did not modify any code (diagnose-only task).
